summary: Added helper scripts for preparing and building from a local workspace copied from a network source.
details: The workspace helper copies the frontend build tree and Python API sources while skipping generated build outputs and logs.
The batch wrapper copies to the local user profile Documents\build_arcrho_app folder and runs the build from there.
Set ARCRHO_LOCAL_BUILD_ROOT to choose a different local build workspace.
Set ARCRHO_LOCAL_BUILD_COPY_THREADS to tune robocopy threading for faster network-to-local copies.
Copy progress is shown by default; set ARCRHO_LOCAL_BUILD_SHOW_PROGRESS=0 to disable the progress scan.
The batch wrapper now asks whether to copy source files before building, and ARCRHO_LOCAL_BUILD_SKIP_COPY=1 can skip the prompt.
When copying is selected, the existing local build workspace is deleted before fresh source files are copied.
